info.title: ExWebsite Server API
info.description:
Frontend 与 Backend 之间的唯一 HTTP API Contract。

该 Contract 由本仓库唯一的 Fastify Server 和 TypeScript 客户端共同使用。
所有 schema 限定在 JSON Schema Draft-07 兼容子集内。

servers.description: 客户端 API base URL；Fastify 仍通过 Glue 的 prefix 显式注册该前缀。

post.summary: Resolve the upload plan for one storage key
post.description: Server selects the medium for this call from runtime configuration unless the caller pins medium. The file branch only returns the current byte ceiling. The cos branch validates configuration, key, declared size and media type before requesting scoped STS credentials and signing the upload ticket, and returns no partial credentials when any step fails. Credentials authorize exactly one key for PutObject. All responses use no-store.

200.description: Upload plan for the resolved medium

post.summary: Upload content through the server and return its URL
post.description: Multipart with exactly one binary data part plus keyword text fields in any order. Repeated fields, unknown fields, more than one file, a missing data part, an invalid media type and a non-multipart request are rejected. An explicit contentType wins, otherwise the part media type is used, otherwise application/octet-stream. The filename never selects the stored path. Bearer authentication completes before any content is consumed. Byte and wire ceilings are enforced while parsing, not from the supplied Content-Length. Two failures answer 503 — exhausted upload slots (STORAGE_BUSY) carries Retry-After, a requested medium that is not enabled (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE) does not. All responses use no-store.

200.description: Stored content URL

post.summary: Confirm a direct cos upload and issue its URL
post.description: Verifies the ticket length and structure, the fixed HMAC algorithm, the signature, the version and validity window, the current session user, the key against the current bucket and region, and the current size ceiling before querying the object. Never issues a request from a region or bucket taken from an unverified ticket. A size above the ceiling returns 413 and a different size than declared returns 409. The client cannot submit a bucket, download host, URL or existence flag. All responses use no-store.

200.description: Stored content URL

get.summary: Read one object from the local file medium
get.description: Public read of the local uploads root only. Directories are never returned as files. Range is unsupported in this version and a Range request still returns the full 200 body. Bytes are sent as application/octet-stream with attachment disposition and MIME sniffing disabled. Failures before the headers are flushed return the error envelope; a failure afterwards terminates the connection instead of appending JSON. The implicit HEAD route stays closed because the contract does not declare it.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Relative storage path previously used for the upload.

200.description: Stored object bytes

get.summary: List the authenticated user's own persistent notifications
get.description: Keyset pagination over the personal sequence, newest first. `view=unread` applies the unread predicate (uncleared, unread, not expired); `view=history` returns every uncleared receipt including read and expired ones. Neither view includes cleared, withdrawn or unauthorized content, and no view writes state. Filters never change the global unread count, which always comes from `GET /notifications/summary`. The cursor is signed and bound to the user, view, filters and an upper sequence bound, so a later page may return fewer rows when authorization or lifecycle changes; the caller deduplicates by `receiptId`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional scope filter. Omitted means all scopes.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional closed category filter. Omitted means all categories.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor returned by a previous page of the same view and filters.

200.description: One page of notification metadata, without bodies.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's global unread count
get.description: Counts the unread predicate over the whole personal history, never the current filter or a loaded page only. Pending projection, cleared, expired, withdrawn and unauthorized receipts are excluded. `stateVersion` is a hint that personal state changed; it is not a cache key for the count because expiry and withdrawal do not always bump it.

200.description: Global unread count and a fresh read-through token.

get.summary: Read one own notification with its safe body and resolved actions
get.description: Read-only. Returns the canonical safe HTML body only when the content schema and policy are still renderable; otherwise `content` is null and the plain-text fallback carries the safe text. A receipt that is no longer visible returns a neutral 404 without leaking the title. Reading does not mark the notification read.

200.description: The notification, its content and its resolved actions.

patch.summary: Mark one own notification read or unread
patch.description: Only the read flag is writable; there is no archive, no arbitrary resource and no body update. `expectedRevision` is the receipt state revision returned by the list or detail call. A stale revision returns 409 without changing state, a no-op does not increment the revision, and a failed write leaves the notification unread.

200.description: The updated receipt state.

post.summary: Mark every currently unread notification read, up to a signed bound
post.description: Global in scope and independent of any list filter. Only receipts that satisfy the unread predicate at execution time and sit at or below `readThroughToken`'s bound are changed; newly arrived or late-projected receipts with a larger sequence stay unread. Cleared, expired and already-read receipts are not rewritten. `requestId` is the idempotency key: replaying it returns the original terminal result without writing state again, and reusing it with a different body returns 409.

200.description: The terminal result for this request id.

post.summary: Preview a non-restorable clear of the whole personal history
post.description: Snapshots every uncleared receipt the caller could see at preview time, regardless of the current filter or of which pages were loaded, and records the exact receipt set with each receipt's clear revision. Clearing cannot be restored, and later arrivals are preserved. The body is closed and empty. The returned token is bound to the caller and expires in 10 minutes; a preview that was never submitted stops being executable when it expires and never stores a body.

200.description: The previewed clear scope and its signed token.

post.summary: Clear exactly the previewed personal history without restoration
post.description: Applies the snapshot recorded by `previewNotificationClear`. Only receipts that still belong to the caller, are still visible, are still uncleared and still carry the previewed clear revision are cleared; a receipt whose clear revision changed or that was cleared from another device is skipped rather than overwritten. Clearing cannot be restored, and later arrivals are preserved. Clearing sets the personal clear state only: it never writes `readAt`, never deletes the source content, event or business record, and never emits a business event or webhook. The result is idempotent per `requestId`.

200.description: The terminal result for this request id.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's notification preferences
get.description: Returns the effective preferences, including defaults for a user with no stored row. Necessary notices are fixed by the catalog and cannot be switched off, so they are reported as explanation only and are never writable. Preferences are independent of `GET /auth/me`.

200.description: The caller's effective notification preferences.

put.summary: Replace the authenticated user's optional notification preferences
put.description: A complete replacement of the optional categories, not a patch. `expectedRevision` must match the stored revision; a stale revision returns 409 and the caller re-reads before retrying. Turning a category off stops future optional projection of that category and never deletes already-delivered history; turning it back on does not re-deliver suppressed events.

200.description: The stored preferences after the update.

get.summary: List Docs spaces
get.description: Public read. Keyset pagination ordered by (createdAt, id) ascending. `limit` defaults to 100 and is clamped to 1..200; `cursor` is opaque and bound to the tree generation. The page never exposes trashed content and never writes state.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same query.

200.description: One page of spaces.

post.summary: Create a Docs space
post.description: Creates one space with its name and description. The caller never supplies id, version, treeVersion or timestamps; those are server-owned fields and are rejected when written.

get.summary: Read one Docs space
get.description: Public read. Returns the current space snapshot including its tree version. Unknown ids and trashed-only content merge into a neutral 404.

200.description: The space snapshot.

patch.summary: Update a Docs space name and description
patch.description: A complete replacement of the name and description, not a partial patch; optional fields would make "clear" ambiguous. `expectedVersion` must match the stored space version, otherwise 409 and the caller re-reads before retrying.

200.description: The space snapshot after the update.

post.summary: Delete an empty Docs space
post.description: Deletion succeeds only when the space currently holds no document row and no template row; it does not require that nothing was ever written. Trashed documents and templates both count as references, so a trashed-only space is still non-empty and cannot be deleted. Uses POST so the version fields are carried in a validated JSON body.

204.description: The space was deleted; no body.

get.summary: Read one level of a space document tree
get.description: Public read. Only active nodes are returned. Omit `parentId` to read the root level; it must never be sent as the string null. An existing but empty level returns 200 with empty items, which never masks an unavailable parent: a parent that does not exist in this space, or that is trashed, is 404, and a parent id owned by another space merges into the same 404. A cursor whose space or parent level does not match the query is 400; a cursor bound to a different tree version is 409 DOCS_TREE_CHANGED and the caller restarts pagination.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Parent document id. Omitted means the root level.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same space and parent.

200.description: One page of active tree nodes and the current tree version.

post.summary: Create a document in a space
post.description: Creates one document under `parentId` (null means the space root) at the position implied by `beforeDocumentId` (null appends to the end of the level). The parent and the anchor must belong to the path space and be active. The body is required; an empty document is expressed as an empty doc or a single paragraph. The request is subject to the 9 MiB content wire budget and to the 8 MiB content profile budget, plus the per-space 10,000 physical row quota.

201.description: The created document and the new tree version.

get.summary: List the current trash roots of a space
get.description: Login required. Returns only roots of the current deletion batches, ordered by (deletedAt, id) descending, with a cursor bound to the tree version. Members of a batch that are not themselves roots are not listed separately.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same space.

200.description: One page of trash groups and the current tree version.

get.summary: List the templates of a space
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 200 DocsTemplatePage shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. Templates belong to exactly one space and the list items never carry the template body.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same space.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Create a template in a space
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 201 DocsTemplate shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. Uses the same 9 MiB content wire budget and 8 MiB content profile budget as document bodies.

201.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

get.summary: Read one active document
get.description: Public read. Returns the normalized body together with the document version and the current tree version. A trashed id, an unknown id and an id that resolves to trashed content all merge into a neutral 404 DOCS_NOT_FOUND, so this operation never discloses trashed content.

200.description: The document and the current tree version.

put.summary: Replace a document title and body
put.description: A complete replacement of title and body under `expectedVersion` and `expectedSpaceId`; the parent, the space and the sibling order cannot be changed here. The returned body is the normalized full snapshot, including filled default attributes and the trailing paragraph, and the caller must use it together with the new version to update local state. Unknown content is never trimmed into a success.

200.description: The saved document and the new tree version.

post.summary: Move or reorder a document
post.description: Moves the document and its whole physical subtree into `targetSpaceId` under `parentId`, at the position implied by `beforeDocumentId`. Source and target space may be identical, which makes this the only sibling reordering operation. The parent and anchor must belong to the target space; a self reference, a descendant target, a wrong-level anchor or an anchor equal to the moved document is 409 DOCS_INVALID_MOVE. When the spaces differ, both levels are reordered and both tree versions are checked.

200.description: The move result, including both affected space versions.

post.summary: Move a document root and its subtree to trash
post.description: Only an active root is accepted. The whole physical subtree is trashed as one deletion batch and stops being readable through the public document read. `trashedCount` counts only the members newly trashed by this call, never members of older batches.

200.description: The trash result, including the deletion batch id.

post.summary: Request an AI content suggestion for a document
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid request, reads no document, calls no model and consumes no credential. The 200 DocsAiSuggestion shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. When implemented, the server reads the current document, checks `baseVersion`, and returns a proposal that is never auto-saved; applying it through updateDocsDocument re-checks the same base version, content profile and space.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Apply a template to a document
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 200 DocsDocumentResult shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. Applying copies the template body and keeps the document title; the document and the template must belong to the same space, and no application record is created.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

get.summary: List the attachments of a document
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid request, performs no query and returns no business data. The 200 DocsAttachmentPage shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same document.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Upload an attachment for a document
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every authenticated request. The multipart payload is never consumed, parsed or validated in this release, so a malformed upload from an authenticated caller can also receive 501; the connection is closed after the fixed error response is flushed. The 201 DocsAttachment shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

201.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

get.summary: List the comments of a document
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid request, performs no query and returns no business data. The 200 DocsCommentPage shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same document.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Create a document comment
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 201 DocsComment shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. There is no inline, selection, range, paragraphId, anchor, from/to or parentCommentId field, and no public author profile protocol in this release.

201.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

get.summary: Read one trashed document
get.description: Login required. The document must currently be trashed; reading an active document through this operation, or an unknown id, returns 404 DOCS_NOT_FOUND. The body and identity fields reuse the document shape while `hasChildren` still counts active direct children only, and the deletion attribution is carried separately in `deletion`.

200.description: The trashed document and its deletion facts.

post.summary: Restore a whole deletion batch
post.description: The path must be the root of the current deletion batch; restoring a non-root member is 409 DOCS_RESTORE_ROOT_REQUIRED. The whole batch is restored in one step and there is no targetSpaceId, parentId, children or includePrevious field. `placement` reports whether the root returned to its original parent or fell back to the space root when that parent is no longer available.

200.description: The restore result and the new tree version.

get.summary: Read one template
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 200 DocsTemplate shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

put.summary: Replace a template name and body
put.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 200 DocsTemplate shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Delete a template
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 204 shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. Deleting a template deletes only the template row and never deletes the body already applied to documents.

204.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release. No body.

get.summary: Read one attachment and its download URL
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid request. The 200 DocsAttachmentAccess shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. The download URL is an absolute HTTP(S) address whose validity is decided by the storage medium and is not a proof of ownership or of the originating request.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Detach an attachment from its document
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 204 shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. Deleting an attachment only removes the association; it never deletes the document and never deletes the stored object.

204.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release. No body.

put.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 200 DocsComment shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now. The body is stored as literal text and is never rendered as HTML.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

post.summary: Delete a comment
post.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid authenticated request. The 204 shape is reserved for a future release and is not returned now.

204.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release. No body.

get.summary: Search active documents
get.description: RESERVED FOR A FUTURE RELEASE: this version returns 501 DOCS_FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every valid request, performs no query and returns no business data. The 200 DocsSearchPage shape below is the reserved success contract and is registered only so the generated client can carry it; it is not returned in this release. When implemented, only active documents are indexed and searched, and excerpts never contain trashed content.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page of the same query.

200.description: Reserved success shape; not returned in this release.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds before a retry is allowed.

ContentDisposition.description: Always attachment; the filename is the last validated key segment, encoded as a quoted-string.

ContentTypeOptions.description: Disables MIME sniffing so stored bytes are never rendered inline.

RetryableErrorResponse.description: Safe application error response with a retry delay

Email.description: 服务端先 trim 再转为小写；按大小写不敏感处理。

Nickname.description: 界面称为用户名，仅作显示名称，允许重复，不用于登录。服务端 trim；业务层按 Unicode 码点限制为 1 至 32。

Password.description: 不 trim、不归一化；业务层按 Unicode 码点限制为 8 至 64。

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded PNG bytes, without a data URL prefix.

JoinApplicationRequest.description: Only multipart: exactly one application/json part (application.json, at most 64 KiB), optional proofs. Unknown parts, duplicate application, truncation and forged markers are rejected; application and all bytes commit atomically.

JoinApplicationQq.description: New application QQ; preserve leading zeroes. Account and legacy summary QQ retain 1?20 digits.

obeyCommunityRules.description: Present on applications submitted by the current form; optional for previously stored version 1 forms.

birthDate.description: Valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date no later than server UTC today; never a timestamp.

freeTime.description: Selected option or actual free text; trim before Unicode code point counting.

JoinNewForm.description: Answer and freeTime strings are trimmed then counted as Unicode code points. The server independently checks calendar and text semantics.

proofs.description: Repeated same-name parts; private raw files must pair one-to-one with validated body markers.

birthDate.description: Valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date no later than server UTC today; never a timestamp.

freeTime.description: Selected option or actual free text; trim before Unicode code point counting.

JoinExperiencedForm.description: Answer and freeTime strings are trimmed then counted as Unicode code points. The server independently checks calendar and text semantics.

proofs.description: Repeated same-name parts; private raw files must pair one-to-one with validated body markers.

originalName.description: Safe basename; reject path separators, controls, dot directory names and header injection characters.

JoinApplicationDetail.description: Strict type/version/form/attachment pairing. Legacy is version 0, null form, no attachments. Corrupted version 1 records are never downgraded.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes, without a data URL prefix.

NotificationCursor.description: 服务端签名的分页游标，绑定本人、视图、筛选与上界；不透明、不可猜测、不可跨身份或跨视图复用。

NotificationToken.description: 服务端签名的短时令牌，绑定本人、用途与到期时间；不可跨身份或跨用途复用。

html.description: 已按当前策略规范化并重新校验的安全 HTML；正文不含脚本、事件属性、样式、内嵌资源或可执行组件。

text.description: 由安全树派生的完整纯文本，供格式不可用时回退展示。

content.description: 当前策略下可安全渲染的正文；不可用时为 null，调用方必须改用 contentFallbackText，不得展示原始 HTML。

NotificationClearPreviewRequest.description: 封闭且为空；清理范围永远由服务端按当时全局未清理历史决定，不接受客户端筛选、行数或时间推断。

necessaryCategories.description: 由 catalog 固定的必要类别，展示说明用，不可写入也不可关闭。

StorageKey.description: 相对存储路径，以 `/` 分段；每段只含小写字母、数字、点、下划线与连字符，段首为字母或数字且段尾不得为点。服务端另外逐段拒绝 Windows 保留设备名，并核对解析路径仍位于 uploads 根目录内；不清洗、不自动小写、不二次 URL 解码。

StorageMedium.description: 目标存储介质；缺省时取运行时配置 STORAGE_DEFAULT_ADAPTER，不回退。

StorageContentType.description: 无参数的 ASCII `type/subtype` 内容声明。服务端不据此验证真实文件格式，也不按后缀推断类型。

StorageByteSize.description: 字节数；上界是 JS 安全整数，实际仍另受运行时 STORAGE_MAX_BYTES 限制。

StorageUnixSeconds.description: Unix 秒时间戳；与 SafeTimestamp 取值域相同，仅单位与语义不同。

StorageUploadTicket.description: 服务器用独立 HMAC 密钥签发的无状态上传凭据，绑定版本、用户、bucket、region、key、申报大小、内容类型与有效期。不写入日志，不缓存。

PrepareStorageUploadResponse.description: 按 medium const 区分的封闭联合；file 分支不签发任何凭据。

StorageUploadRequest.description: 仅用于 multipart。恰好一个二进制 data part，以及限定的 key、medium、contentType 文本字段；重复字段、未知字段、多文件与截断都被拒绝。data 的值是由解析器生成的占位标识，handler 必须核对可信解析上下文，伪造的 JSON 占位不能绕过真实解析。

url.description: 绝对 HTTP(S) 地址。本地 URL 由配置的公开 API 基址生成，在服务器可达期间有效；COS URL 是签发起一年的签名地址，不提供续签。

DocsVersion.description: 乐观并发版本号；不接受字符串或小数。

DocsCursor.description: 不透明分页游标；null 表示没有下一页。游标绑定树版本代际，不能当作权限证明，也不能跨空间或跨父层复用。

DocsTitle.description: 文档标题；服务端 trim 后按 Unicode 码点限制为 1 至 200，拒绝全空白。

DocsSpaceName.description: 空间名与模板名；服务端 trim 后按 Unicode 码点限制为 1 至 100。

DocsDescription.description: 空间描述；保留正文空白，不做 trim。

DocsContentSchemaVersion.description: 持久内容协议版本；不等于文档 version 或 Tiptap npm 版本。未知版本明确拒绝，不猜测转换。

parentId.description: 父文档 ID；null 表示根层。树 operation 只返回活动节点。
父文档 ID；null 表示根层。

hasChildren.description: 只计活动直接子节点；已回收行的该值通常为 false，其存在不授予读取子树的能力。

affectedCount.description: 本次文档字段实际更新的去重行数；成功 no-op 至少更新根。跨空间包含两侧同级重排。

trashedCount.description: 仅本次新回收的成员，不包含旧批次。

parentId.description: 回收根当时的父文档 ID；null 表示根层。

retainedTrashedCount.description: 恢复后仍位于该根物理子树中的其他回收批次成员，不计已经独立恢复并脱离的节点。

DocsUpdateSpaceRequest.description: 空间更新同时提交名字和描述，避免可省略字段与清空语义混淆。

parentId.description: 父文档 ID；null 表示创建在根层。父与锚点必须属于 path 空间且活动。

beforeDocumentId.description: 同级重排锚点；null 表示追加到同级末尾。

DocsSaveDocumentRequest.description: 完整替换标题与正文；不允许改父、改空间或改顺序。

parentId.description: 目标父文档 ID；null 表示目标空间根层。父与锚点必须属于目标空间。

beforeDocumentId.description: 目标同级重排锚点；null 表示追加到同级末尾。

DocsTrashDocumentRequest.description: 只接受活动根；整棵物理子树一起进入回收站。

DocsRestoreDocumentRequest.description: 恢复当前整批；path 必须是该批次的根。没有 targetSpaceId、parentId、children 或 includePrevious 字段。

DocsAiSuggestionRequest.description: AI 不接受调用方提交整篇待保存正文；只提交指令并核对 baseVersion。

DocsTemplateSummary.description: 模板列表项；字段与 DocsTemplate 相同，只是不含正文。

DocsApplyTemplateRequest.description: 应用模板只复制正文并保留文档标题；文档与模板必须同空间。模板不建立应用记录。

sha256.description: 小写十六进制 SHA-256；不外发 medium 或 storage key。

downloadUrl.description: 绝对 HTTP(S) 地址；有效期由介质决定，不承诺永久可用。

DocsAttachmentUploadRequest.description: 仅用于 multipart。恰好一个二进制 data part，以及限定的 fileName、contentType、expectedSpaceId、expectedDocumentVersion 文本字段；不允许 medium、key、url 或 ticket。filename 不决定存储路径，路径由服务端生成。

DocsDeleteAttachmentRequest.description: 附件删除是解除关联，不删除文档，也不自动删除存储对象。

body.description: 保留字面文本，不作为 HTML；拒绝全空白。没有 inline、selection、range、anchor 或 parentCommentId 字段。

DocsTiptapDocument.description: 持久正文的完整 Tiptap profile 1 JSON（锁定 Tiptap 3.32.0 完整富文本预设）。本 schema 只约束 JSON 形状与有限值域：Server 另外独立校验节点语法、父子关系、Mark 组合、表格逻辑网格、Unicode 与内容预算（8 MiB 正文、10,000 节点、深度 32、表格网格 10,000）。不接受 Markdown、HTML 字符串、Yjs 数据或浏览器 Editor 对象；null 不是空正文。

content.description: 输入允许空数组，Server 规范化为至少一个 paragraph；禁止嵌套 doc。

DocsTiptapNode.description: 非 doc 节点的封闭 union；23 个分支靠各自的 type const 互斥，每次只应匹配一个分支。属性对象同样封闭，未知属性由 Server 明确拒绝。

text.description: 唯一允许声明 text 的节点；不能有 attrs 或 content。

type.description: JSON 中持久为字符串形式。

content.description: 只含 text 节点，不带 Marks；保留代码空白。

DocsTiptapImage.description: src 没有默认值，因此 attrs 不可省略。

src.description: 安全地址；profile 1 关闭全部 Data URL，不接受 javascript、blob、file 或其他协议，Image 不允许 mailto。

DocsTiptapMention.description: id 没有默认值，因此 attrs 不可省略。

id.description: 内容身份，不是授权凭据。

open.description: profile 1 的 Node schema 始终包含 open；persist 是扩展选项而不是文档属性，提交它明确拒绝。

content.description: 由 Server 强制为恰好一个 detailsSummary 加一个 detailsContent。
只接受可格式化的 text 节点；不接受 hardBreak、Mention 或块节点。
不保存 DOM colgroup、View 或布局按钮。
零或多个 cell/header；不设 minItems。上方单元格的 rowspan 可以完整覆盖后续行，因此空行合法，最终仍须通过逻辑网格策略。

colwidth.description: 非空时数组长度必须等于 colspan，每项为 0 至 8192 的整数。
非空时数组长度必须等于 colspan，每项为 0 至 8192 的整数。

DocsTiptapMark.description: 8 类 Mark 的封闭 union；单个 inline 节点每类最多一个。重复 Mark、互斥组合和错误位置都由 Server 拒绝，不靠合并或丢弃修复。

DocsTiptapMarkCode.description: 沿用完整预设的排他规则，不与其他 Mark 混用。

DocsTiptapMarkLink.description: href 没有默认值，因此 attrs 不可省略。

href.description: 安全地址；Link 另允许有目标的 mailto。_blank 由服务端补入 noopener/noreferrer。

rel.description: 仅由 noopener、noreferrer、nofollow 组成，去重并固定 token 顺序。

DocsTiptapMarkTextStyle.description: 不允许 fontFamily、lineHeight 或任意 style/class。

fontSize.description: 只接受 px/rem 并换算为 0.75 至 3 rem 的有限数值；不接受 NaN、Infinity、calc 或百分比。

FeedbackBugSubmissionForm.description: 新建 Bug 反馈必须选择问题分类。

form.description: 新建 Bug 反馈必须选择问题分类；其他类型的分类仍可留空。已接收记录的表单快照按 FeedbackForm 读取。
